_keys.band: [lo, hi] level range of the pack
_keys.hubs: h = index+1 used by quest entities. n quests, svc = inn/fm/zep/stable nearby
_keys.part: sub-region letter if the band was cut for size, with the zones in `zones`
_keys.quests.ex: exclusiveTo: quests that lock this one out
_keys.quests.f: finisher entity, same shape as s; the string 's' means same entity as the starter
_keys.quests.fl: flags: elite group escort dungeon profession rep breadcrumb chainHead class:<TOKEN>
_keys.quests.l: questLevel (requiredLevel/1 if the DB says scaling)
_keys.quests.o: objectives: k c creature | o object | i item | t explore trigger, x=1 from extraObjectives; i id, n name, t text, lv [minLevel, maxLevel], rk rank (0 normal 1 elite 2 rare-elite 3 boss 4 rare; for items = easiest source), c up to 2 clusters {z zone, x, y, r radius, n spawns}, sp total spawns, src top drop sources [npc, name], ns total drop sources if more were considered
_keys.quests.of: objective-first hint from Forever: item | killCredit
_keys.quests.pa: preQuestGroup: all of these must be turned in first
_keys.quests.r: races the quest is limited to (absent = all faction races)
_keys.quests.rw: reward items: i, n, c item class, s subClass, il itemLevel, rl requiredLevel, up=1 upgradeCandidate (weapon/armor above the level baseline), bag=1 container
_keys.quests.s: starter entity {k: n|o|i npc/object/item, i, n, z, x, y, h hub}
_keys.quests.sa: up to 2 alternative starters as [k, i, n, z, x, y]
_keys.quests.xp: XP reward at questLevel (xpDB-classic), absent if unknown
_keys.quests.z: primary zone id (starter zone, else finisher, else zoneOrSort)
_keys.xpBudget: XP needed to climb lo -> hi (Classic table); aim for 110-130% in the route
_keys.zones: i = zone id, n = name, q = quests starting there, lv = [min, max] quest level

quests.t: Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room of the Scholomance. Defeat Vectus, then return to Betina Bigglezink.
Find Pamela's doll.
Speak with Marlene, south of the Ruins of Andorhal.
Bring Davil's Libram and Redpath's Shield to Carlin Redpath.
Bring the Skull of Horgus and the Shattered Sword of Marduk to Carlin Redpath at Light's Hope Chapel.
Bring 5 Resonating Skulls and the Mystic Crystal to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

o.t: Slay ghouls to free Darrowshire spirits
Slay ghouls to free Darrowshire spirits
Slay ghouls to free Darrowshire spirits

quests.t: Free 15 Darrowshire Spirits and return to Carlin Redpath.
Recover 10 Plagued Flesh Samples from Stratholme and return them to Betina Bigglezink. You suspect that any creature in Stratholme would have said flesh sample.
Travel to Stratholme and search the ziggurats. Find and return new Scourge Data to Betina Bigglezink.
Find Ezra Grimm's smoke shop in Stratholme and recover a box of Grimm's Premium Tobacco. Return to Smokey LaRue when the job is done.
Find Carlin Redpath.

Travel to Stratholme, in the north. Search the supply crates that litter the city and recover 5 Stratholme Holy Water. Return to Leonid Barthalomew the Revered when you have collected enough of the blessed fluid.
Travel to Stratholme and find Archivist Galford of the Scarlet Crusade. Destroy him and burn down the Scarlet Archive.
Take the Head of Balnazzar to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Venture to Stratholme and destroy Baron Rivendare. Take his head and return to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff.
Speak with Lord Maxwell Tyrosus. He is inside the church.
Open the Argent Hold and claim your reward.
Find Egan. You only know that he was last seen around Stratholme.

Use Egan's Blaster on the ghostly and spectral citizens of Stratholme. When the restless souls break free from their ghostly shells, use the blaster again - freedom will be theirs! Free 15 Restless Souls and return to Egan.
Travel to Stratholme and find Menethil's Gift. Place the Keepsake of Remembrance upon the unholy ground.
Take the Soulbound Keepsake to Leonid Barthalomew in Eastern Plaguelands.
Return to Magistrate Marduke in Caer Darrow. Show him the Soulbound Keepsake.
Bring 10 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Breechlock at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.
Bring 25 Argent Dawn Valor Tokens to Quartermaster Breechlock at Light's Hope Chapel, Eastern Plaguelands.
Kill 20 Plagued Hatchlings, then return to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel.
Bring the Frozen Eggs to Betina Bigglezink.
Slay 20 Plaguehound Runts, 5 Plaguehounds and 5 Frenzied Plaguehounds. Return to Tirion Fordring when the task is complete.
Slay 30 Plaguebats and return to Tirion Fordring.
Seek out the Carrion Grubs and Devourers of the region. Slay them and harvest their meat. Return to Tirion Fordring when you have gathered 15 Slabs of Carrion Worm Meat.
Bring the Healthy Dragon Scale to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
Listen to what Tirion Fordring has to say.

o.t: Search the false grave for the Taelan's Hammer.

quests.t: Travel to the Undercroft - at the southernmost section of the Eastern Plaguelands - and recover Taelan's Hammer. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.
Travel to Northdale, in the northeastern region of the Eastern Plaguelands, and recover the Symbol of Lost Honor. Return to Tirion Fordring upon completion of your objective.
Travel to island of Caer Darrow, in the south-central region of the Plaguelands, and look for any clues as to the whereabouts of the painting.
Travel to Uther's Tomb, located in the southern Plaguelands. Show Myranda the Hag Tirion's Gift.
Take the Bundle of Relics to Chromie in Andorhal.
Bring Joseph's Key to Joseph's Chest.
Bring Zaeldarr's Head to Caretaker Alen at Light's Hope Chapel.

Travel to Corin's Crossing to the east and slaughter the Scourge that inhabit the town. Collect 7 pieces of Living Rot in under 10 minutes. Use the Mortar and Pestle to grind the Living Rot into Coagulated Rot.
Kill Infiltrator Hameya. Use his key on the Mound of Dirt behind the Undercroft.
Smokey LaRue wants you to get 2 Thorium Bars, 1 Golden Rod, 8 Hi-Explosive Bombs, and 8 Unstable Triggers. You will have to find a blacksmith and an engineer for these items.

quests.n: When Smokey Sings, I Get Violent
quests.t: Travel to Plaguewood, northwest of Light's Hope. Destroy 8 Scourge Structures by using Smokey's Special Compound at the Mark of Detonation planted inside each building. Smokey has had the Ziggurats and Slaughterhouses marked. Once you plan…
Slay 20 Noxious Plaguebats and 10 Monstrous Plaguebats. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when you are finished.

Travel to the northern borders of the Eastern Plaguelands and recover the Quel'Thalas Registry. The item is somewhere in the Quel'Lithien lodge. You must also slay 8 Rangers, 8 Pathstriders, and 8 Woodsmen.

quests.n: Duskwing, Oh How I Hate Thee...
quests.t: Find Duskwing and slay him. From the corpse, recover a Patch of Duskwing's Fur and return it to Nathanos Blightcaller. It is said that Duskwing roams the countryside to the north of Marris Stead.
Find Borelgore in the northern wastes of Eastern Plaguelands and destroy him. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller when the mission is complete.
Travel to the Undercity and speak with Varimathras.

Travel to Tyr's Hand, southeast of the Marris Stead. Once there, take a bite of the Rotten Apple. While under the guise of the Scarlet Crusade, deliver the Grand Crusader's Command to Crusader Lord Valdelmar.
Return to Nathanos Blightcaller with the new information.

The Scarlet Crusade is on the move. Somewhere along the road from Tyr's Hand to Stratholme you will find the Oracle, Demetria, and her entourage. Hunt her down and slay her. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller should you succeed.
Travel to Stratholme and slay Ramstein the Gorger. Take his head as a souvenir for Nathanos.
Bring Augustus' Receipt Book to Augustus the Touched in Terrordale.
